description: Verify user registration with valid credentials
steps:
1. Open web application
2. Navigate to Registration form
3. Enter valid unique username, email, and password (>=6 chars)
4. Click "Register" button
5. Verify server response and database entry
expected: HTTP 200 OK. User registered successfully. JWT token issued. User record created in SQLite with secure password hash.
actual: As expected. User registered with HTTP 200, JWT token returned, record inserted in users table.

description: Verify duplicate username or email registration prevention
steps:
1. Open registration form
2. Enter existing username or registered email
3. Click "Register" button
4. Verify validation error response
expected: HTTP 400 Bad Request. System displays "Username or email already exists". No duplicate record inserted.
actual: As expected. Returned HTTP 400 with duplicate error message; database integrity preserved.

description: Verify password length boundary validation (<6 characters)
steps:
1. Open registration form
2. Enter valid username and email
3. Enter password shorter than 6 characters (e.g. 5 chars)
4. Click "Register"
expected: HTTP 400 Bad Request. Validation error: "Password must be at least 6 characters long."
actual: As expected. Server rejected registration with minimum password length error.

description: Verify user login with case-insensitive email
steps:
1. Open Login modal
2. Enter registered email in lowercase or mixed case
3. Enter valid password
4. Click "Sign In"
5. Verify authentication token generation
expected: HTTP 200 OK. Case-insensitive email normalization authenticates user; returns valid JWT access token.
actual: As expected. Normalized email match succeeded; JWT token stored in browser session.

description: Verify login failure with invalid credentials
steps:
1. Open Login modal
2. Enter incorrect password or non-existent username
3. Click "Sign In"
4. Verify rejection message
expected: HTTP 401 Unauthorized. Detail: "Invalid username/email or password." (Prevents user enumeration).
actual: As expected. HTTP 401 returned with generic authentication error.

description: Verify protected endpoint authorization guard without Bearer token
steps:
1. Send direct GET request to /api/history without Authorization header
2. Verify require_auth security dependency blocks request
expected: HTTP 401 Unauthorized with header WWW-Authenticate: Bearer. Detail: "Authentication required."
actual: As expected. Access blocked with HTTP 401 and WWW-Authenticate challenge.

description: Verify image upload maximum file size enforcement (>10 MB limit)
steps:
1. Select leaf image file exceeding 10 MB threshold (e.g. 11 MB)
2. Submit file via POST /predict
3. Verify upload guard interception before model inference
expected: HTTP 413 Payload Too Large. Server rejects upload with "File exceeds maximum allowed upload size of 10 MB."
actual: As expected. HTTP 413 returned immediately, saving memory and compute resources.

description: Verify invalid MIME type file upload rejection
steps:
1. Upload a non-image file (.txt, .pdf, or .exe) to diagnosis zone
2. Send multipart request to /predict
3. Verify file type validation guard
expected: HTTP 400 Bad Request. Server responds with "Invalid file type. Please upload a valid crop leaf image (JPEG/PNG/WebP)."
actual: As expected. HTTP 400 returned; non-image payload rejected before image processing.

description: Verify empty zero-byte file upload handling
steps:
1. Attempt to upload a 0-byte file with image extension
2. Submit request to /predict
3. Verify empty file validation
expected: HTTP 400 Bad Request. Detail: "Uploaded file is empty."
actual: As expected. HTTP 400 returned with "Uploaded file is empty."

description: Verify ViT-Base dual-head prediction on real diseased leaf (Potato Early Blight)
steps:
1. Upload real field sample `Potato_Early-Blight-1.jpg`
2. Image normalized to 224×224 via ImageNet transform
3. Execute ViT-Base dual-head forward pass (55 plants, 175 diseases)
4. Compute joint likelihood and geometric mean confidence
5. Inspect diagnosis results
expected: HTTP 200 OK. Correctly identifies Crop: "Potato", Disease: "Early Blight", Status: "Diseased", Confidence > 70.0%, and returns 5-pillar advisory.
actual: As expected. Diagnosed Potato Early Blight with 86.4% confidence and complete treatment recommendations.

description: Verify healthy plant leaf identification and status categorization
steps:
1. Upload healthy leaf photograph (e.g. healthy tomato foliage)
2. Run inference through ViT dual heads
3. Verify is_healthy flag and status label
test_data: Image: Healthy Tomato leaf image (field sample)
expected: HTTP 200 OK. `is_healthy`: true, `Status`: "Healthy", `Disease`: "Healthy", UI displays green health badge.
actual: As expected. Correctly classified as healthy with green status badge and preventative guidance.

description: Verify non-crop / out-of-distribution leaf gating (<40.0% confidence)
steps:
1. Upload non-leaf image (indoor room, human face, furniture) or blurry object
2. Process through /predict endpoint
3. Verify confidence threshold gating (<40.0%) and false advisory suppression
test_data: Image: Random background object photo resulting in joint confidence < 40.0%
expected: HTTP 200 OK. `is_background`: true, `Crop`: "Non-Crop / Low Confidence", `Disease`: "No Plant Leaf Detected", `Status`: "Uncertain", `Advisory`: null (prevents false diagnosis).
actual: As expected. Out-of-distribution photo gated with "No Plant Leaf Detected"; false advisory suppressed.

description: Verify monotonic confidence ranking across top-3 differential predictions
steps:
1. Perform model inference on leaf image
2. Extract `top_3_predictions` array `[Rank 1, Rank 2, Rank 3]`
3. Verify mathematical invariant: `Conf(Rank 1) >= Conf(Rank 2) >= Conf(Rank 3)` and `Top Conf == Conf(Rank 1)`
test_data: Image tensor `(1, 3, 224, 224)` evaluated across all 333 candidate pairs
expected: Confidence scores strictly monotonic descending: `Rank 1 >= Rank 2 >= Rank 3`. Calibrated geometric mean formula guarantees monotonicity.
actual: As expected. Verified in `test_dpd_model.py`: Rank 1 (92.5%) >= Rank 2 (4.5%) >= Rank 3 (2.0%).

description: Verify complete 5-pillar clinical treatment advisory resolution
steps:
1. Diagnose plant disease via ViT engine
2. Resolve advisory metadata from `disease_info.json`
3. Verify presence of all 5 clinical treatment pillars
expected: Advisory object contains 5 non-empty pillars: `symptoms`, `cause`, `organic_treatment`, `chemical_treatment`, `prevention`.
actual: As expected. All 5 pillars populated with actionable biological and chemical spray dosages.

description: Verify 100% advisory coverage across all 333 supported pairs
steps:
1. Iterate all 333 pairs in `dpd_crop_rankings.json`
2. Match each pair against `disease_info.json` via `_match_advisory()`
3. Assert zero missing records and zero empty pillars
expected: Zero missing advisory entries; 100% coverage with non-empty content in all 5 pillars across all 333 pairs.
actual: As expected. Verified in `test_taxonomy_contracts.py`: 333/333 pairs have complete 5-pillar advisory data.

description: Verify multi-candidate fallback matching for disease naming conventions
steps:
1. Query `_match_advisory()` with varied naming formats (raw class, snake_case, title case)
2. Verify resolution to identical knowledge base record
expected: Robust multi-key fallback maps all variant formats to verified advisory record without key error.
actual: As expected. All naming variations resolved to target advisory details.

description: Verify authenticated clinical PDF report generation and download
steps:
1. Authenticate user and run scan to create prediction #1
2. Send `GET /api/prediction/1/pdf` with `Authorization: Bearer <token>`
3. Inspect PDF stream binary, MIME type, and disposition header
test_data: Prediction ID: 1, User ID: 1, Valid Bearer JWT token
expected: HTTP 200 OK. `Content-Type: application/pdf`. Attachment filename: `crop_disease_report_1.pdf`. Valid ReportLab PDF binary with farmer info, leaf photo, and 5-pillar tables.
actual: As expected. Generated professional clinical PDF diagnostic report (>15 KB) matching diagnosis.

description: Verify cross-user authorization guard on PDF download (IDOR prevention)
steps:
1. User A generates prediction record #1
2. User B logs in and attempts to access User A's report: `GET /api/prediction/1/pdf`
3. Verify IDOR security barrier
test_data: User A ID: 1, User B ID: 2, Target Prediction: #1, User B Token
expected: HTTP 403 Forbidden. Server responds with "Forbidden: You are not authorized to access this prediction report."
actual: As expected. Cross-user access blocked with HTTP 403; private health scans protected.

description: Verify prediction scan persistence in SQLite with WAL mode
steps:
1. Logged-in user submits leaf photo for diagnosis
2. Query SQLite `predictions` table
3. Verify `user_id`, `crop`, `disease`, `confidence`, `image_path`, `created_at`
test_data: User ID: 1, Crop: "Potato", Disease: "Early Blight", Confidence: 92.5%, Image: `"uploads/scan_abc.jpg"`
expected: Record inserted into predictions table in WAL mode; fast indexing via `idx_predictions_user_created`.
actual: As expected. Scan record persisted with unique ID and timestamp.

description: Verify user prediction history query (`GET /api/history`)
steps:
1. Perform multiple scans under authenticated user account
2. Send `GET /api/history` with Bearer token
3. Verify records returned in reverse chronological order
expected: HTTP 200 OK. Returns array of past scans containing date, crop, disease, confidence score, and thumbnail path (`ORDER BY id DESC`).
actual: As expected. Returns 3 history records sorted by latest scan first.

description: Verify analytics dashboard filters out non-crop scans
steps:
1. Log 1 genuine disease prediction (Late Blight, 94.0%)
2. Log 3 non-crop test scans (15.0%, 18.0%, 12.0%)
3. Call `GET /api/statistics`
4. Verify `total_scans == 4`, `top_disease == "Late Blight"`, `avg_confidence == 94.0%`
expected: `total_scans`: 4, `top_disease`: "Late Blight", `avg_confidence`: 94.0. Non-crop scans excluded from pathology analytics and average confidence.
actual: As expected. Verified in `test_api.py`: `avg_confidence` is 94.0% (not deflated to 34.7%).

description: Verify browsable disease catalog deduplication and alphabetical sorting
steps:
1. Send `GET /api/library`
2. Parse returned library array
3. Assert zero duplicate `(crop, disease)` combinations
4. Assert alphabetical sorting by crop name
expected: HTTP 200 OK. Zero duplicate entries. Catalog sorted strictly alphabetically by crop name, then disease name.
actual: As expected. Verified in `test_api.py`: zero duplicates and sorted alphabetically.

description: Verify multi-crop taxonomy integrity contract (333 pairs across 55 crops)
steps:
1. Verify `dpd_crop_rankings.json` against `dpd_55_plants.json` (0-54) and `dpd_175_diseases.json` (0-174)
2. Validate head index bounds
3. Confirm exactly 333 viable pairs
expected: Exact match: 55 crops, 175 diseases, 333 pairs. Plant index in [0, 54], disease index in [0, 174].
actual: As expected. Verified in `test_taxonomy_contracts.py`: all taxonomy invariants held.

description: Verify system health liveness and deep readiness probes
steps:
1. Send `GET /health` (liveness)
2. Send `GET /health/ready` (readiness)
3. Verify model loading flag and database connectivity
expected: `/health` returns HTTP 200 `{"status": "ok"}`. `/health/ready` returns HTTP 200 `{"status": "ready", "model_loaded": true, "database_connected": true}`.
actual: As expected. Both probes return HTTP 200 confirming model and database are online.

description: Verify REST API dual-route compatibility (`/predict` and `/api/predict`)
steps:
1. Submit leaf image to `POST /predict`
2. Submit identical image to `POST /api/predict`
3. Compare response schemas and diagnostic output
test_data: Valid leaf photo uploaded to both endpoints
expected: Both routes return HTTP 200 OK with identical JSON payload structure and confidence scores.
actual: As expected. Both `/predict` and `/api/predict` routes work identically; 100% backward and REST compatible.
